grain: one frozen Formal Entry event; exactly 505 rows
cutoff: Entry T close; no T+1 data
snapshot_integrity_only: Snapshot open verifies all physical constituent hashes including D8; no D8 rows or columns are loaded as feature data.
hypothesis_shortlist_gate: For H5 <= -10% incidence in normal-close rows: same monotonic direction across all nonempty bins in development and descriptive 2026, at least 10/5 rows in each extreme bin respectively, and absolute extreme-bin incidence difference >= 0.10 in development. Retain at most three; never approve a filter.

left_tail_outcome_labels.FAILED_REBOUND_TP5: TP5_H5 closed without a TP exit; null if unresolved/censored
left_tail_outcome_labels.TP5_THEN_DEEP_REVERSAL: H5 signal MFE >= 0.05 and H5 comparable close return <= -0.05

diagnostic_target: Normal-close Entry, with board conditional summary separate
multiple_testing: Nine univariate features and two prespecified cross-tabs; no p-value hunting or parameter search
deferred: MA10/MA20 without a frozen qualified primitive
exact V3 hit positions not in frozen Observation CSV
market/context features without canonical PIT contracts
raw-return windows crossing corporate actions may be distorted without an allowed signal-side adjustment
